# Technology logo attribution

These assets identify the technologies used by the portfolio. Their owners'
marks remain their property; this site does not claim sponsorship or affiliation.
Raw publisher assets and checksums are retained in the source archive under
design/technology-logos/original/ and scripts/technology-logo-sources.json.

The jade variants change paint only. Paths, contours, holes, source transforms,
and relative proportions are retained. No decorative outlines or effects are added.

| Technology | Publisher / author and source | Treatment |
| --- | --- | --- |
| JavaScript | Community JS logo by Christopher Williams and Manu Sporny; [logo.js](https://github.com/voodootikigod/logo.js), MIT license embedded in the SVG | Jade field, white original glyphs |
| React | Meta Platforms, Inc. and affiliates; [React documentation brand SVG](https://github.com/reactjs/react.dev/blob/main/public/images/brand/logo_dark.svg) | Original vector contours, jade fill |
| Python | Tim Parkin; Python Software Foundation; [official logo assets](https://www.python.org/community/logos/) | Exact two-snake contours; jade monochrome, decorative shadow omitted |
| Docker | Docker, Inc.; [official brand kit](https://www.docker.com/company/newsroom/media-resources/) | Original ocean-blue mark served byte-for-byte |
| Git | Git Logo by Jason Long; [Git logo downloads](https://git-scm.com/community/logos); [CC BY 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/) | Original black logomark geometry, jade fill |
| Linux | Original Tux by Larry Ewing, made with GIMP; [kernel.org credit](https://www.kernel.org/faq.html). Published monochrome vector from [Devicon](https://github.com/devicons/devicon/blob/master/icons/linux/linux-plain.svg), MIT | Unchanged Tux vector, jade fill |
| C | Published language icon from [Devicon](https://github.com/devicons/devicon/blob/master/icons/c/c-original.svg), MIT | Original C shape, jade fill |
| Java | Duke, the Java mascot, Sun Microsystems / Oracle; [OpenJDK Duke Project vector](https://github.com/openjdk/duke/blob/master/vector/Wave.svg) | Original 2D Duke contours; jade/white fill, canvas fit to existing clip rectangle |
| C# | Microsoft; [official C# training SVG](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/training/achievements/get-started-c-sharp-part-1.svg) | Exact current C# contour and glyph, isolated from surrounding course badge; flat jade/white |
| SQL | Published SQL language/file-type icon from [vscode-icons](https://github.com/vscode-icons/vscode-icons/blob/master/icons/file_type_sql.svg), MIT | Original vector layers, jade fill |
| HTML | W3C; [HTML5 logo](https://www.w3.org/html/logo/); [CC BY 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/) | Unchanged contours, jade/white |
| CSS | Javi Aguilar and the CSS-Next Community Group; [current official logo](https://github.com/CSS-Next/logo.css), CC0 1.0 | Unchanged current contours and lettering, jade/white |

C and SQL have no universal official language logo. Their entries use established,
published language icons rather than claiming a fictional standards-body mark.

The [Python FAQ](https://www.python.org/psf/trademarks-faq/) permits color changes
while requiring the two-snake outline, eyes and separation to remain intact.
Python and the Python logo are trademarks of the Python Software Foundation.
This portfolio is not affiliated with the PSF.

Docker's official guidelines restrict unapproved colors, so its original approved
blue symbol is retained, while the adjacent portfolio text uses jade.

[Oracle's Java guidance](https://www.oracle.com/a/ocom/docs/java-licensing-logo-guidelines-1908204.pdf)
recommends the open-source BSD-licensed Duke mascot for Java affinity. The
commercially licensed coffee-cup mark is not used.

The [CSS-Next guidelines](https://github.com/CSS-Next/logo.css) permit color
adaptation while retaining legibility and the provided geometry.

License texts for Devicon, vscode-icons, CSS and React are in licenses/.
JavaScript's publisher license remains embedded in its SVG. CC BY attributions
and links for Git and HTML are retained above and in SVG descriptions.
